name: Apply for Police Clearance Certificate (PCC)
summary: How to apply for a Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) through the Passport Seva Online Portal: register, fill in and submit the online application, pay the fee and book an appointment, then visit the Passport Seva Kendra or Regional Passport Office with your original documents.
steps: Register through the Passport Seva Online Portal (click the "Register" link on the Home Page).
Log in to the Passport Seva Online Portal with the Login ID you created.
Click the "Apply for Police Clearance Certificate" link.
After selecting the Regional Passport Office (RPO), fill in each step of the form: Passport Type, Applicant Details, Family Details, Address Details, Other Details and Self Declaration.

Carefully validate the details, then submit the application: it cannot be changed once submitted. A unique Application Reference Number (ARN) is generated. You can also save the application at any point and resume later.

Start the payment and appointment process by clicking View > Pay and Schedule Appointment. Prior payment of the applicable Passport service fee is mandatory for booking appointments at all Passport Seva Kendras.

Select the Online Payment option and the 'Appointment Quota' (Normal/Tatkaal; Tatkaal is available only to applicants with a Tatkaal application), then the preferred Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK). The system shows the next available appointment date.

After verifying the details, click the Pay and Book Appointment button and complete the payment on the payment gateway. The Appointment Confirmation screen then shows the appointment details. To reschedule, use the Schedule/Reschedule Appointment link: appointments can be rescheduled three times, or once for Tatkaal.

Click the "Print Application Receipt" link to print the receipt with the Application Reference Number (ARN)/Appointment Number. Carrying the printout is no longer required: an SMS with your appointment details is also accepted as proof of appointment.

Visit the Passport Seva Kendra (PSK)/Regional Passport Office (RPO) where the appointment has been booked, with your original documents. If you do not visit within 90 days of the online form submission, the application form must be submitted again.
